headline: Pirelli sees wear indicators hit 100% after 15 laps in Qatar
body: Front-left tyres reached 100% wear in places after 15 laps of high-fuel running on Friday, with graining on all three compounds and degradation of up to 0.2 seconds a lap. Pirelli is reviewing the 27-lap stint cap and the 29psi front pressure after the gravel cuts it found in returned tyres.
